SBI Circle Based Officers CBO Interview Letter 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the Interview Letter for the recruitment of Circle Based Officer (CBO) Posts on the official website of the SBI. This recruitment was released for 2050 posts. Applications for the SBI Circle Based Officers CBO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 29, 2026, to February 26, 2026. The Interview examination will be held from 13 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SBI Circle Based Officers CBO Interview Letter 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 January 2026
  • Last Date : 25 February 2026
  • Last Date For Fees Payment : 25 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 14 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 06 March 2026
  • Result : 30 June 2026
  • Interview Letter : 04 July 2026
  • Interview Start Date : 13 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

SBI Circle Based Officers CBO Interview Letter 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 25 February 2026.

The official website is: https://sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
